purpose: model-free test of whether reliably measured quiet-first tail events show a pre-onset cross-scale precursor; no classifier fit
reason_years_start_2022: older 15s support is too sparse under authoritative missing-observation semantics; no carry-forward assumption
event_family: quiet_first_tail only, using frozen V3 thresholds
feature_time: minute e-2 close for event minute e; at least one minute before earliest possible event-minute onset
primary_score: 0.5*((logE30-logE240)+(logE60-logE240)) using trailing 15s endpoint-grid Haar energies smoothed over physical 5 minutes

controls.eligibility: same symbol/year/afternoon/exact minute, V3 quiet precondition, not a first-tail event, known minute sigma_pre and rv480, no first-tail event in +/-30 minutes within session
controls.matching: 100 nearest eligible controls in standardized (log sigma_pre, log rv480) Euclidean distance; scale estimated from eligible controls within each symbol-year

primary_statistic: mean within-set percentile rank of event primary_score among its matched control pool; 0.5 is null center
random_reference: 10000 draws, one uniformly chosen matched control per event set, preserving event-specific control pools; seed 20260907
report: number of reliable quiet-first events and excluded events
fraction reference mean >= observed (descriptive Monte Carlo tail fraction, not fresh-OOS p-value)
symbol/year breakdown and leave-one-year-out primary mean percentile
interpretation: post-V2 consumed-history mechanism diagnostic; can establish presence/absence of a measurable precursor pattern in this sample, not deployable predictive validity
do_not: treat missing observations as unchanged price
promote subgroup result as fresh validation
